content.title: Wait! Is XO, Kitty coming back for season 4? Here's what we know about the Netflix show's future
content.text: From the start of season three of XO, Kitty there was an air of finality, fuelled mostly by Kitty's (Anna Cathcart) Sunset List – a bucket list of all the things she wanted to experience in her last year at K.I.S.S, including acing her exams, connecting more deeply with the Korean side of her family, making new memories with her found family of friends and, the "most pressing item" on her list, defining her relationship with her heated romantic interest Min Ho (Sang Heon Lee). Not to mention that after two seasons and two To All the Boys appearances (one from Noah Centineo's Peter and the other from Janel Parrish's Margot), fans finally – finally! – got the long-awaited cameo from Lara-Jean (Lana Condor). "It's such a joy to be able to come back and see Anna," Condor told Netflix's Tudum. "I think she did an amazing job creating the XO, Kitty world. It's such a dream to be able to work with her again. I feel really excited and happy and honoured I get to be back." NetflixThat, plus the fact that season three is centred on Kitty's senior year at school, the third instalment has an 'end of an era' feel. But despite all signs pointing towards closure, there was nothing remotely finale-esque about the way season three wrapped. So will we get a season four of XO, Kitty?XO, Kitty season 3's ending spoilers follow from this point. What to Read NextWhile Kitty and Min Ho may have firmed up their dating status, there are still so many things up in the air when it comes to their relationship and general diverging paths in life. The central pair are not the only ones whose futures have question marks over them. Advertisement - Continue Reading BelowXO, Kitty is ripe for another series but has it been picked up for season four already? Here's everything we know about an XO, Kitty season four renewal. Will there be an XO, Kitty season 4? Prime VideoAt the time of writing there has been no official confirmation that XO, Kitty will be back for season four, but surely it's only a matter of time before it gets green-lit? The show's series finale certainly left things open for the story to continue, with Min Ho and Kitty flying back to her hometown of Portland to meet her family over the winter break. This huge relationship milestone seems perfect on the surface, but it also happened on a whim and Min Ho was not prepared. How will the family's impression of their relationship impact it?We also couldn't imagine Cathcart saying no to being reunited with Kitty for another season. "I feel so lucky that I've gotten the chance to hold hands with her as we both grew up," the actor told The Hollywood Reporter in January 2025. "I admire her in a lot of ways, and I think I can learn from her. I'm very lucky to have this weird sense of almost like a friendship in her, even though I know we are one and the same. "She is very fearless in a lot of ways that I wish I could be, and she's very brave because she kind of leads with her heart all the time, and I feel that especially in this season."NetflixShe continued: "Sometimes she has so much love inside of her, it just spills out in different moments in different ways. There's something really courageous about that and really beautiful to see that in a character. I think that is something that I always want to take from Kitty." What will happen in XO, Kitty season 4?NetflixAdvertisement - Continue Reading BelowMuch to our utter delight, Kitty and Min Ho weren't the only ones who managed to revive their romantic relationship by the close of season three. After a long separation Yuri (Gia Kim) and Juliana (Regan Aliyah) found their way back to each other without all the game play, making this new leg of their relationship feel more solid. Dae (Minyeong Choi) and Eunice (Han Bi Ryu) dodged the teen-pregnancy bullet and managed to turn their situationship into something more meaningful, while Q (Anthony Keyvan) and Jin (Joshua Lee) narrowly escaped a break-up and are rebuilding their bond. NetflixEven professor Alex (Peter Thurnwald) and Kitty's cousin Jiwon (Hojo Shin) coupled up and now have a baby on the way. However with the end of season threatening to put oceans between these teens, as they choose different further education and career paths across the globe, what will come of all these pairings? Season four would likely explore their relationships in depth and may even spill past graduation to see how they fare in the real world. With Kitty off to New York to study at NYU and Min Ho chasing his dreams within the music industry, will they try to make it work long-term? Or call it quits?NetflixSpeaking of long term, XO, Kitty frightened us with the potential break up of Lara-Jean and Peter but was quick to rectify things before the end with the pair working things out. However fans will no doubt be rabid to ensure that this reconciliation lasts, so there is a possibility that they will feature in any further seasons. As for the main XO, Kitty crew, both Dae and Yuri have been forced down more difficult and unconventional career paths. Despite acing his exams Dae was rejected from his university of choice, while Yuri's family's financial situation now makes it difficult for her to explore further education. NetflixAdvertisement - Continue Reading BelowDae, like Min Ho, has been bitten by the music bug and means to explore that further. Similarly Yuri seems to have found her feet in the field of fashion, but how will their exciting new ventures pan out? Only a season four could possibly tell. Q and Jin's relationship is also uncertain. The boyfriends may have stitched it back together, but are they endgame or heading for splits-ville? Finally we couldn't imagine XO, Kitty ending without the show bringing things full circle with a grand storyline or scene that brings Kitty closer to the very thing that brought her to Seoul Korea in the first place – her mother. NetflixAs well as jetting across the world for romantic love, Kitty had been trying to find a way to feel closer to her late mother. Through this journey she has achieved that, but it wouldn't be very XO, Kitty if this part of the show's narrative arc wasn't wrapped up with a huge, sparkly bow.
